title: Rebel
lines: The 500/1000 Abralon TM surface finished with Factory Finish Polish is perfect for medium oil patterns. The added texture underneath the polished finish allows the Rebel to perform at its best.
Our new Rebel core has been designed to create more revolutions for the bowler which in turn creates a stronger reaction on the lane.
Our NBT Pearl pushes the Rebel through the front part of the lane enhancing its reaction at the back end.
Are you tired of the same old boring night on the lanes? Are you looking to mix things up? Well, it’s time to make a change! Dare to be different, be a Rebel!
Recommended Cleaner: Powerhouse Energizer Ball Cleaner
FACTORY FINISH 500/1000 Abralon® Polished w/ Powerhouse™ Factory Finish Polish
